purpose: Ingest and capacity-screen one defined large-order net-inflow factor from licensed daily classified trades before observing factor returns.

source_selection.formal_account_history: The provider documents unrestricted historical depth for a formal JQData account, subject to the purchased product entitlement.
source_selection.public_eastmoney_alternative_rejected: The unauthenticated per-stock fund-flow endpoint returned only the latest 120 sessions for four representative A-shares on 2026-07-15, so it cannot support the frozen 2019-2025 development period.
source_selection.raw_exchange_level2_deferred: Raw ten-level books, order queues, tick orders, trades, and cancellations remain licensed exchange market data. They are not required until this lower-cost defined daily classification is accepted and tested.

provider_definitions.xl: transaction with at least 500000 shares or CNY 1000000
provider_definitions.l: transaction with at least 100000 shares or CNY 200000 and below the xl threshold
provider_definitions.m: transaction with at least 20000 shares or CNY 40000 and below the l threshold
provider_definitions.s: transaction below 20000 shares or CNY 40000, preserving the provider's documented wording
provider_definitions.net_fields_policy: Do not request provider netflow fields; derive differences from the eight nonnegative inflow/outflow fields and verify the formula locally.

point_in_time_policy.source_time_field: time normalized to local trade date
point_in_time_policy.documented_availability: daily data at 19:00 after the signal session
point_in_time_policy.signal_assignment: signal-session close for a following-local-session-open entry
point_in_time_policy.residual_risk: A provider delay beyond its documented daily update time can make data unavailable for the next open; acceptance and full sync must retain retrieval timestamps.

factor.name: jqdata_large_order_net_inflow_share
factor.denominator: inflow_xl + inflow_l + inflow_m + inflow_s + outflow_xl + outflow_l + outflow_m + outflow_s
factor.zero_denominator_policy: exclude the observed stock-day and keep the factor missing
factor.negative_or_missing_raw_policy: exclude and count incomplete rows; any negative raw amount aborts the partition because raw inflow and outflow amounts must be nonnegative

snapshot_contract.universe_membership: use only instrument intervals overlapping each requested date; do not infer membership from present-day names

required_checks: returned keys are unique and inside the requested date/symbol set
all eight raw amount fields are numeric and nonnegative
stored schema contains no forbidden, price, market-cap, credential, or return field
positive-denominator ratios equal the frozen local formula and lie in [-1, 1]
retrieval timestamp and provider are recorded
all four active acceptance symbols are returned unless provider entitlement or a documented suspension explains absence
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: stop without a large sync, capacity audit, price access, or substitute endpoint

coverage_and_capacity_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop without reading returns, changing thresholds, switching direction, or adding raw Level-2 fields
